design.quote: This pre-specified analysis of DICTATE-AHF evaluated 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission

population.value: Patients with acute heart failure (AHF) randomized within 24 hours of hospital admission
population.quote: 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission

sample_size.quote: evaluated 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission

intervention.quote: randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission to dapagliflozin 10 mg daily or structured usual care

comparator.quote: dapagliflozin 10 mg daily or structured usual care, with protocolized IV diuretics in both groups

primary_findings.outcome: Diuretic efficiency (weight loss) - eGFR as effect modifier
primary_findings.quote: eGFR at randomization did not modify dapagliflozin's treatment effect on diuretic efficiency assessed by weight loss (interaction p = 0.22)

primary_findings.outcome: Change in eGFR from randomization to end-of-study
primary_findings.quote: Dapagliflozin was not associated with a decrease in eGFR (p = 0.89)

primary_findings.outcome: Change in blood urea nitrogen (BUN) from randomization to end-of-study
